analyst.summary: RailTel is a railway-telecom PSU with a genuinely large and growing order book (over 11,000 crore, roughly 2.6 times annual revenue) and a real diversification underway into data centers as part of India's broader digital-infrastructure buildout. The balance sheet is very clean (almost no debt) and management is guiding to about 20% revenue growth next year. Quarterly results are lumpy, as is typical for a government-project business, so we would look through any single quarter's swings to the order-book trend, which remains supportive.
